summary: Iteration 2: verified Marketplace + Payment + Admin tabbed CRUD (products & settings). Backend: 24/24 pytest cases passed (added 8 tests for products list/CRUD/auth/validation and settings get/update/auth). Frontend: /marketplace loads 10 seeded products with ₹ prices, WhatsApp order links (https://wa.me/...&text=...) work, search filters correctly (Vibhuthi->1). /payment shows QR placeholder, UPI ID, payee name, amount input updates upi:// intent with am=<amt>, Copy button present, Confirm-on-WhatsApp link valid. Admin: login works via ENTER button, 3 tabs (gallery/products/settings) all present, product create/edit-price/delete round-trip verified end-to-end, settings update+reload persists (verified WA change persisted after page reload then restored). Gallery admin tab still functional.

issues: When all nav links + 'Marketplace' + 'Payment' are visible at xl breakpoint, the 'SIGN IN' link wraps to two lines ('SIGN' / 'IN') because of tight spacing next to CONTACT link. Purely cosmetic.

action_items: (Optional/cosmetic) Prevent 'SIGN IN' text wrap in top nav by adding whitespace-nowrap or small font/gap adjustment at xl breakpoint.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: /api/products PUT/POST always require full image_data (validated). Consider partial update semantics on PUT to avoid clients needing to re-upload full base64 blob when editing just price/name.
SettingsIn.upi_qr_image cap is 2MB (2_000_000 chars) which is fine, but MongoDB doc size limit could still be a concern for future large QRs; consider storing under GridFS.
server.py products_update swallows unknown fields silently (only whitelisted set-fields). This is safe but consider returning validation errors for unknown keys.
Duplicate concern from iter1: JWT_SECRET default 'change-me' still in place — HIGH for production only.
seed_data_creation: None persistent. Test created TEST_ui_<ts> product and deleted it. Settings modified and restored to original values.

Admin dashboard tabs live at /admin (post-login) with data-testids admin-tab-{gallery,products,settings}. Marketplace/Payment pages fully data-testid covered.
